body.en:
Definition and physical properties

Ammonia, NH3,is a nitrogen–hydrogen compound and the main intermediate for many nitrogen fertilizers. It is a colourless, pungent gas at ordinary conditions, lighter than air as a pure gas, readily liquefied by appropriate cooling/pressure and very soluble in water. Released cold liquid/vapour can form a dense hazardous cloud despite the pure-gas density comparison.

Chemical properties

NH3 is a weak base in water:NH3+H2O⇌NH4++OH−.It neutralises acids to ammonium salts, is oxidised to nitric-oxide/nitric-acid intermediates under suitable catalytic conditions, and supplies nitrogen for urea formation with CO2.It is incompatible with several oxidisers and unsuitable materials;aqueous alkalinity does not make it harmless.

Applications

Feed for urea, nitric acid, ammonium salts and phosphates;other qualified uses include industrial refrigeration and chemical synthesis. Safety/grade requirements differ by service. No direct field-dose or handling advice is implied.

વ્યાખ્યા તથા Physical Properties

Ammonia, NH3,nitrogen–hydrogen compound તથા અનેક nitrogen fertilizers નું મુખ્ય intermediate છે. Ordinary conditions માં colourless, pungent gas છે;pure gas air કરતાં હળવો, યોગ્ય cooling/pressure થી liquefy થતો તથા water માં ખૂબ soluble છે. Cold liquid/vapour release થી dense hazardous cloud બની શકે;ફક્ત pure-gas density પરથી safe માનવું નહીં.

Chemical Properties

Water માં NH3 weak base છે:NH3+H2O⇌NH4++OH−. Acids સાથે ammonium salts બનાવે છે, catalytic oxidation થી nitric-acid intermediates તથા CO2 સાથે urea માટે N આપે છે. કેટલાક oxidisers/materials સાથે incompatible છે;aqueous alkalinity એટલે harmless નહીં.

Applications

Urea, nitric acid, ammonium salts/phosphates માટે feed;qualified industrial refrigeration તથા chemical synthesis માં પણ ઉપયોગ. Service મુજબ safety/grade જુદાં છે;field dose/handling advice નથી.

Definition and physical properties

Nitric acid, HNO3,is a mineral acid used to supply nitrate nitrogen and in chemical manufacture. Pure acid is colourless;dissolved nitrogen oxides may impart yellow/brown colour. It is miscible with water and corrosive. Conventional HNO3–water distillation has an azeotropic limitation, so stronger acid requires a suitable concentration route.

Chemical properties and uses

It is a strong acid and a powerful oxidising agent:neutralisation forms nitrate salts and reactions with reducing/organic materials can be dangerous. Nitrogen-oxide formation depends on reactants and conditions. Uses include qualified nitrate fertilizers and chemical intermediates;never mix nitric acid with incompatible organics in an improvised apparatus.

Definition and physical properties

Urea, CO(NH2)2,is an amide fertilizer and carbon–nitrogen compound, not an ammonium salt. It is a white crystalline, water-soluble solid, sold in qualified prilled/granular forms. Moisture uptake, caking and particle-size distribution affect storage and spreading. Pure-compound theoretical N content is about46.65%;commercial analysis must be read separately.

Chemical properties and uses

Hydrolysis can release ammonia through the action of urease. Upon excessive thermal exposure, urea can form biuret with ammonia loss;biuret is therefore a quality concern. Urea supplies fertilizer N and is also an industrial chemical feed, including selected resin and diesel-exhaust-fluid manufacture with strict grade requirements.

Definition / selected route

Ammonia synthesis gas is a purified hydrogen–nitrogen mixture prepared for the synthesis loop;steam reforming is one representative hydrogen-generation route.

Raw materials and principle

Qualified hydrocarbon feed, steam, air for the selected secondary-reforming route, and treatment/absorption media.

CH4+H2O ⇌ CO+3H2;CO+H2O ⇌ CO2+H2;CO+3H2→CH4+H2O.

Source identification

Page2A is a general hydrogen/syngas route;2B adds secondary reforming with air to provide nitrogen for ammonia synthesis. Follow reforming→secondary reforming→shift→CO2 removal→methanation/other final purification. Do not treat the hydrogen-only upper route as already containing the required nitrogen.

Original reference—page 2

Construction and equipment arrangement

The plant has feed desulfurisation, a fired tubular primary reformer, a secondary air-contact reformer, heat-recovery equipment, shift beds, CO2 absorption/regeneration and final gas purification. The source upper figure illustrates hydrogen processing;the lower figure identifies the nitrogen-supplying secondary stage.

1.Feed treatment and reforming

Sulfur removal protects nickel-containing reforming and downstream catalysts. The hydrocarbon/steam stream receives heat through primary-reformer tubes, converting much of the feed to H2 and CO.Secondary reforming with controlled air completes further conversion and introduces nitrogen;its oxygen is consumed rather than being carried as a synthesis reactant.

2.Shift, CO2 removal and final cleanup

Heat recovery cools the gas and raises useful steam. Shift conversion reacts CO with steam to increase H2 and form CO2;subsequent cooling separates condensed water. The CO2 absorber transfers acid gas into solvent and the regenerator releases a concentrated CO2 stream. Final methanation or the specified alternate purification reduces catalyst-poisoning carbon oxides.

3.Synthesis-feed boundary

The cleaned gas is checked for composition and impurities before compression to synthesis service. The selected air-based route adjusts the hydrogen/nitrogen balance;the hydrogen-only alternate requires separate nitrogen addition. Nitrogen ratio adjustment and impurity removal are different tasks.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Control sulfur breakthrough, steam/carbon balance, tube heat flux, carbon deposition, shift temperature, solvent condition and final carbon-oxide leakage. Heat integration reduces fuel duty butdoes not replace catalyst protection.

Applications / product boundary

Purified ammonia feed;recoverable CO2 may serve an appropriately integrated urea unit.

Source ની ઓળખ

પાનું 2A general hydrogen/syngas route છે;2B માં secondary reforming ના air થી ammonia માટે nitrogen આવે છે. Reforming→secondary reforming→shift→CO2 removal→final purification સમજાવવું. Upper hydrogen-only route માં જરૂરી N2 છે એવું ન માનવું.

મૂળ Reference—પાનું 2

Construction તથા Equipment Arrangement

Plant માં feed desulfurisation, fired tubular primary reformer, secondary air-contact reformer, heat recovery, shift beds, CO2 absorption/regeneration તથા final purification છે. Upper figure hydrogen processing અને lower figure N2 આપતો secondary stage બતાવે છે.

1.Feed Treatment તથા Reforming

Sulfur removal reforming/downstream catalysts બચાવે છે. Hydrocarbon/steam ને primary-reformer tubes થી heat મળે છે અને feed નો ભાગ H2/CO માં convert થાય છે. Controlled air વાળું secondary reforming further conversion તથા N2 supply આપે છે;O2 consume થાય છે, synthesis reactant તરીકે આગળ નથી જતું.

2.Shift, CO2Removal તથા Final Cleanup

Heat recovery gas cool કરીને useful steam આપે છે. Shift માં CO+steam થી H2/CO2 વધે છે;cooling થી condensate અલગ પડે છે. CO2 absorber gas ને solvent માં લે છે અને regenerator concentrated CO2 આપે છે. Final methanation/alternate purification catalyst-poisoning carbon oxides ઘટાડે છે.

3.Synthesis-feed Boundary

Cleaned gas ને compression પહેલાં composition/impurities માટે તપાસાય છે. Air-based route માં H2/N2 balance adjust થાય છે;hydrogen-only alternative માં અલગ N2 જોઈએ. Ratio adjustment તથા impurity removal જુદાં કામ છે.

મુખ્ય Engineering / Quality બાબતો

Sulfur breakthrough, steam/carbon balance, tube heat flux, carbon deposition, shift temperature, solvent તથા final carbon oxides નિયંત્રિત કરવા. Heat integration થી duty ઘટે છે, પણ catalyst protection નો બદલો નથી.

ઉપયોગો / Product Boundary

Purified ammonia feed;recoverable CO2 યોગ્ય integrated urea unit માં જઈ શકે.

Definition / selected route

Partial oxidation produces CO/H2-rich raw gas by incomplete oxidation of a hydrocarbon feed;it is an alternative synthesis-gas front end.

Raw materials and principle

Hydrocarbon feed, qualified oxidant and steam/water for heat control and downstream conversion. The methane equation is illustrative, not an assertion that every source feed is methane.

CH4+½O2→CO+2H2;CO+H2O⇌CO2+H2.

Source identification

Original partial-combustion sheet:feed preheating, oxygen-fed gas generation, waste-heat/steam handling, shift and acid-gas absorption/regeneration. The dashed acetylene alternative is not the chosen ammonia route. Nitrogen must subsequently be supplied/adjusted;oxygen-fed gas is not automatically3:1H2:N2.

Original reference—page 1

Construction and equipment arrangement

The reference contains feed preheating, an oxygen-fed generator, heat recovery/scrubbing, shift conversion and an acid-gas absorber/stripper. Purge, wash and particulate-recovery functions depend on the feed;the drawing contains a separate acetylene alternative.

1.Gas generation and heat recovery

Controlled incomplete oxidation supplies heat and generates carbon monoxide/hydrogen. The hot gas transfers heat to recovery equipment and is cleaned of feed-dependent soot/solids. This is not complete combustion to CO2 and water, nor is the raw gas already purified ammonia feed.

2.Shift and acid-gas recovery

Where hydrogen is required, steam shift converts part of CO to CO2 and additional H2.Absorption removes CO2 and other specified acid gases;solvent regeneration permits reuse. A final appropriate cleanup removes remaining catalyst poisons before the ammonia train.

3.Nitrogen addition

An oxygen-fed generator does not provide the nitrogen carried in air-blown secondary reforming. A separately qualified nitrogen stream and ratio adjustment are required for ammonia service. The optional acetylene route in the scan is outside the selected fertilizer synthesis-gas path.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Oxidant containment, refractory integrity, soot removal, heat recovery and sulfur/carbon-oxide cleanup are major issues.

Applications / product boundary

Alternative hydrogen/synthesis-feed generation after full conditioning.

Source ની ઓળખ

મૂળ Reference—પાનું 1

Construction તથા Equipment Arrangement

Reference માં feed preheating, oxygen-fed generator, heat recovery/scrubbing, shift તથા acid-gas absorber/stripper છે. Purge, wash/particulate duties feed મુજબ હોય છે;acetylene નો અલગ alternative બતાવેલો છે.

1.Gas Generation તથા Heat Recovery

Controlled incomplete oxidation થી heat તથા CO/H2 મળે છે. Hot gas ની heat recover થાય છે તથા feed-dependent soot/solids દૂર થાય છે. આ complete combustion નથી અને raw gas પહેલેથી purified ammonia feed નથી.

2.Shift તથા Acid-gas Recovery

H2 જોઈએ ત્યારે steam shift થી CO નો ભાગ CO2 તથા વધારાના H2 માં ફેરવાય છે. Absorption થી CO2/selected acid gases દૂર થાય છે;regeneration થી solvent reuse થાય છે. Final cleanup catalyst poisons દૂર કરે છે.

3.Nitrogen Addition

Oxygen-fed generator air-blown secondary reforming જેટલું N2 આપતો નથી. Ammonia માટે separate qualifiedN2 તથા ratio adjustment જોઈએ. S can નો optional acetylene route પસંદ કરેલા fertilizer syngas path માં નથી.

મુખ્ય Engineering / Quality બાબતો

Oxidant containment, refractory integrity, soot removal, heat recovery તથા sulfur/carbon-oxide cleanup મુખ્ય બાબતો છે.

ઉપયોગો / Product Boundary

Full conditioning પછી alternative hydrogen/synthesis-feed generation.

Definition / selected route

An ammonia synthesis converter is a pressure-contained catalytic reactor in which purified H2/N2 partially converts to ammonia;this is a axial multi-bed teaching section.

Raw materials and principle

Purified synthesis gas and a qualified catalyst, commonly promoted iron in conventional plants;other catalyst technologies have different requirements.

Source identification

New labelled conceptual section, not a manufacturer drawing or pressure-vessel design.

Separate labelled study drawing

Construction and equipment arrangement

A pressure shell encloses catalyst baskets, retaining/support screens and internal flow passages. The drawing shows serial catalyst beds with inter-bed cooling or qualified cold-gas quench connections. The dashed inner boundary is conceptual internal separation/insulation, not a specified proprietary shell design.

1.Gas distribution

Preheated feed is distributed above the first bed and flows mainly along the vessel axis through the catalyst. A support screen retains catalyst while allowing gas passage;channeling would bypass active material.

2.Reaction and heat management

Catalytic ammonia formation releases heat. A rising temperature speeds reaction only within useful limits;higher temperature also reduces equilibrium ammonia yield. Inter-bed cooling/quench or the selected heat-exchange arrangement brings gas to an appropriate next-stage condition without confusing cooling with product separation.

3.Effluent and design comparison

Gas leaves the final axial bed for heat recovery and ammonia condensation. Multiple beds limit temperature rise and distribute conversion;long catalyst flow paths can contribute to pressure drop.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Control feed purity, catalyst condition, temperature profile, pressure drop and internal bypassing. Mechanical details require the actual licensed design;the sketch is not vessel-sizing guidance.

Applications / product boundary

Ammonia synthesis loop;ammonia condensation occurs downstream, not automatically inside each catalyst bed.

body.en:
Definition / selected route

The Kellogg ammonia route integrates hydrocarbon-derived synthesis-gas preparation with catalytic ammonia synthesis and unreacted-gas recycle.

Raw materials and principle

Qualified desulfurised hydrocarbon, steam, air, catalysts and appropriate CO2-removal medium.

N2+3H2⇌2NH3(exothermic, equilibrium-limited).

Source identification

Original page3 is angled and partly clipped at the right;page4 supplies a readable block diagram. Desulfuriser, primary/secondary reformers, heat recovery, HT/LT shift, CO2 absorber/stripper, methanator, compression, ammonia converter, chilling/separation and gas recycle/purge must be explained separately. Missing clipped labels are not asserted as readable.

Original reference—page 3

Original reference—page 4

Construction and equipment arrangement

The source sequence contains primary/secondary reformers, HT/LT shift, CO2 absorber/stripper, methanator, multi-stage compression, converter, heat exchangers, chilling and ammonia separator. A recycle compressor returns synthesis gas, and a purge controls accumulated inert species.

1.Prepare and purify synthesis gas

Desulfurisation and reforming generate hydrogen and introduce the selected nitrogen supply. HT/LT shift increases hydrogen recovery;CO2 removal and methanation protect the ammonia catalyst. The block drawing on page4 helps identify stages obscured at the clipped right edge of page3.

2.Compress, preheat and react

Purified gas is compressed and exchanges heat with hot converter effluent. The catalytic beds convert only part of each pass because reaction equilibrium and kinetics limit conversion. Exothermic heat must be managed through the designed inter-bed cooling/heat-recovery arrangement, rather than simply increasing temperature indefinitely.

3.Condense, separate and recycle

Cooling/chilling condenses ammonia while much of the unreacted H2/N2 remains gaseous. The separator sends qualified liquid ammonia to storage and gas back through the recycle loop. A controlled purge prevents methane/argon accumulation;purge recovery or authorised fuel use is a separate boundary.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Catalyst poisons, compressor reliability, heat removal, inert accumulation, ammonia carryover and leak containment dominate plant operation.

Applications / product boundary

Qualified ammonia for fertilizer manufacture and other specified industrial duties.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા / પસંદ કરેલો Route

કાચો માલ તથા સિદ્ધાંત

Definition / selected route

The illustrated Linde ammonia concept separates hydrogen purification from nitrogen production and then forms the synthesis mixture.

Raw materials and principle

Pretreated hydrocarbon, steam, an authorised hydrogen-purification system and nitrogen from a separate qualified air-separation unit.

N2+3H2⇌2NH3.

Source identification

This is a distinct source route using feed treatment, steam reforming, shift, CO2 removal, molecular-sieve/PSA purification and nitrogen from a separate unit. Do not add both a mandatory nitrogen-producing secondary reformer and a full separate-N2 route indiscriminately. Optional CO2 stream may serve urea.

Original reference—page 5

Construction and equipment arrangement

The source includes feed pretreatment, primary/steam reforming, shift, CO2 removal, a molecular-sieve/PSA purification block, a separate nitrogen unit and ammonia synthesis. The adsorption block is functional:specific commercial bed arrangements differ.

1.Hydrogen production

Pretreatment removes sulfur before steam reforming. Shift uses remaining steam to convert carbon monoxide and raise hydrogen yield. CO2 removal precedes the specified final adsorptive purification;the optional recovered carbon dioxide can serve an integrated urea plant.

2.Purification and nitrogen blending

Adsorption-based purification separates a hydrogen-rich product from undesirable components;regeneration/off-gas follows its own engineered handling path. Qualified nitrogen is supplied separately and blended for synthesis. This avoids claiming that the primary reformer itself produces nitrogen from steam.

3.Synthesis and product recovery

The mixed gas is compressed and supplied to the ammonia synthesis/recycle system. Ammonia is recovered by cooling and separation while unconverted gas recycles. The source does not justify adding every Kellogg secondary-reformer duty to this separate-nitrogen arrangement.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Check adsorbent performance, nitrogen purity, gas ratio and catalyst poisons;purge gas can be a qualified fuel only after appropriate assessment.

Applications / product boundary

Alternative integrated ammonia manufacture;not a second mandatory stage after the Kellogg process.

Storage systems

Anhydrous ammonia may be stored in engineered pressurised vessels or in appropriately refrigerated large storage systems;aqueous ammonia is a different product/service. Vessels, piping, valves, seals, materials and instrumentation must be selected for ammonia conditions, including compatibility and cold-temperature behaviour. Relief systems, containment, gas detection and access control are safety functions, not optional accessories.

Transportation and transfer

Approved road/rail tankers, ships or pipelines are selected according to quantity, condition and applicable rules. Trained personnel use authorised connections, inspection and transfer procedures with verified receiving capacity and emergency arrangements. No tank-filling, pressure-setting or emergency isolation sequence is prescribed here. Ammonia leaks can cause toxic exposure and cold/chemical burns;evacuate to safety and follow the site emergency organisation rather than attempting an untrained repair.

Definition / selected route

The ammonia-oxidation route makes nitric acid by catalytic NH3 oxidation, NO oxidation and absorption of nitrogen oxides in water.

Raw materials and principle

Qualified ammonia, clean air and absorption water with a suitable oxidation-catalyst system.

4NH3+5O2→4NO+6H2O;2NO+O2→2NO2;3NO2+H2O→2HNO3+NO.

Source identification

Original air compressor/ammonia mixer→catalytic converter→heat-recovery boiler→catalyst-recovery filter→tail-gas heater/economiser→oxidation/absorption tower. Condensate and dilute-acid streams enter the recovery system. Printed historical conditions/percentages are not adopted as a validated recipe.

Original reference—page 7

Construction and equipment arrangement

The source has compressed-air/ammonia mixing, catalytic converter, heat-recovery boiler, catalyst-recovery filter, tail-gas heater, steam economiser, condensate separation and oxidation/absorption tower. The tower provides gas–liquid contact and cooling;the converter is not an acid-storage vessel.

1.Catalytic oxidation and heat recovery

The prepared gas mixture contacts the oxidation catalyst and forms mainly NO under the selected industrial regime. The hot effluent supplies recoverable heat/steam. The catalyst filter recovers carried catalyst material;downstream cooling and condensate handling prepare gas for oxidation and absorption.

2.NO oxidation and absorption

NO reacts with oxygen to form NO2;cooled absorption in water generates nitric acid and releases some NO for reoxidation. Contacting, cooling and available oxygen therefore affect recovery together. Dilute acid/condensate streams are returned according to the source recovery boundary.

3.Product and tail gas

The product leaving absorption is a specified aqueous acid, not automatically anhydrous nitric acid. Tail gas passes through its engineered heat-recovery/emission-control system. Unabsorbed NO xmust not be assumed harmless because the main acid product has been collected.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Catalyst selectivity/loss, heat removal, corrosion, absorption efficiency and NO xabatement are major problems. All operating conditions belong to the validated plant design.

Applications / product boundary

Nitrate-fertilizer manufacture and qualified chemical processes.

Definition / selected route

Magnesium-nitrate-assisted concentration changes nitric-acid/water separation so concentrated acid can be recovered beyond ordinary simple-distillation limitations.

Raw materials and principle

Dilute HNO3 and concentrated aqueous Mg(NO3)2 with compatible construction materials.

Separation by reduced water activity/relative-volatility change;not conversion of nitrate salt into product acid.

Source identification

Page6 labels strong magnesium nitrate at the column feed butcalls a bottom stream weak sulfuric acid—an internal source inconsistency. For the syllabus Mg(NO3)2 route, the water-rich nitrate solution goes to salt-solution reconcentration, not a sulfuric-acid loop. A corrected separate study flow is provided;the original is retained unaltered.

Original reference—page 6

Separate labelled study drawing

Construction and equipment arrangement

An extractive-distillation column contacts acid with the salt solution. Acid vapour goes to an overhead condenser and bleaching/de-NO xfinishing. The water-rich salt bottoms have their own reconcentrator, cooler and return line;they are not the source of a new sulfate reagent.

1.Water retention and acid overhead

The concentrated nitrate solution lowers water activity and changes relative volatility, retaining more water in the liquid phase. The acid-rich vapour is condensed;entrained salt must be prevented from contaminating product. Nitrate salt acts as a separation aid rather than a stoichiometric acid-forming reactant.

2.Bleaching and salt recovery

The finishing column removes dissolved nitrogen oxides under the engineered arrangement. Water-rich Mg(NO3)2 solution is reconcentrated to restore useful separation strength, cooled as required and recycled. Make-up/purge controls losses and impurities. This recovery loop corrects the inconsistent sulfuric-acid label on owner page6.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Corrosion, salt carryover, water balance, reconcentration energy and NO xhandling determine feasibility. Do not copy source percentages as universal specifications.

Applications / product boundary

Production of a qualified concentrated nitric-acid grade.

Definition / selected route

Urea manufacture combines ammonia and carbon dioxide through carbamate formation and dehydration;the selected route recovers unconverted material by CO2 stripping.

Raw materials and principle

Qualified NH3 and CO2,catalyst-free synthesis chemistry, and approved water/steam/cooling services.

2NH3+CO2⇌NH2COONH4;NH2COONH4⇌NH2CONH2+H2O.

Source identification

Source figure is a simplified Stamicarbon-type stripping flow:reactor, CO2 stripper, high-pressure carbamate condenser/return, lower-pressure recovery, vacuum evaporation and prilling. CO2 is both feed and stripping gas;unconverted NH3/CO2 are recovered as carbamate. Avoid mixing the Montecatini recovery scheme into this loop without identifying an alternative.

Original reference—page 8

Construction and equipment arrangement

The source includes a synthesis reactor, CO2-fed stripper, high-pressure carbamate condensation/return, lower-pressure decomposition/recovery, vacuum concentration and prilling equipment. The pressure levels are functional stages, not interchangeable tanks.

1.Carbamate formation and urea production

Ammonia and CO2 first form ammonium carbamate;part of the carbamate then dehydrates to urea and water. Equilibrium leaves unconverted reactants alongside urea. A single reactor pass therefore does not imply complete raw-material conversion, and excess water can reduce the useful synthesis driving force.

2.Stripping and reactant recovery

The stripper uses incoming CO2 to assist removal of unconverted ammonia/carbamate-derived gas from the liquid. The recovered NH3/CO2 is condensed/absorbed as a compatible carbamate stream and returned through the selected high-pressure loop. Lower-pressure recovery treats remaining reactants separately.

3.Concentration and solid finishing

Vacuum evaporation removes water from the purified urea solution before the selected prilling or granulation stage. The solidification system removes heat and develops the intended particle form. Screening/cooling and grade testing follow;long hot residence can increase biuret rather than improve quality.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Carbamate corrosion, water balance, recycle recovery, passivation according to design, biuret formation, ammonia emissions and solids caking require control.

Applications / product boundary

Specified fertilizer urea or other qualified urea grades;fertilizer grade is not automatically suitable for every industrial/automotive service.

NH3/CO2 પહેલાં ammonium carbamate આપે છે;તેનો ભાગ dehydrate થઈ urea/water બને છે. Equilibrium થી unconverted reactants બાકી રહે છે;single pass complete conversion નથી. Excess water synthesis driving force ઘટાડે છે.

2.Stripping તથા Reactant Recovery

Stripper માં incoming CO2 liquid માંથી unconverted NH3/carbamate-derived gas દૂર કરવામાં મદદ કરે છે. NH3/CO2 compatible carbamate stream રૂપે condense/absorb થઈ HPloop માં પાછાં જાય છે. બાકી reactants નું LPrecovery અલગ થાય છે.

3.Concentration તથા Solid Finishing

Vacuum evaporation purified solution માંથી water કાઢે છે;પછી selected prilling/granulation થાય છે. Solidification થી heat દૂર થઈ intended particles બને છે. Cooling/screening તથા grade tests પછી આવે છે;લાંબા hot residence થી biuret વધે છે.

મુખ્ય Engineering / Quality બાબતો

Carbamate corrosion, water balance, recycle recovery, design મુજબ passivation, biuret, NH3 emissions તથા caking નિયંત્રિત કરવા.

Definition / selected route

The source Montecatini route is a urea autoclave/flash-recovery scheme with a different recovery boundary from CO2 stripping.

Raw materials and principle

Qualified ammonia and CO2,with high-pressure recycled carbamate solution.

2NH3+CO2⇌NH2COONH4⇌NH2CONH2+H2O;2NH2CONH2→NH2CONHCONH2+NH3(biuret side reaction).

Source identification

Page9 explicitly identifies Montecatini:autoclave, flash evaporator, flash drum, vacuum concentration and prilling, with high-pressure solution recycle and a separate low-pressure NH3-bearing stream to by-product use. Page10 is a staged-decomposition teaching sketch. It is not proof that every urea process recycles all gases in one identical loop.

Original reference—page 9

Original reference—page 10

Construction and equipment arrangement

Page9 shows an autoclave, flash evaporator, flash drum, vacuum concentration and prilling tower. Page10 shows a related teaching sequence of staged dissociators followed by evaporation;its stream names and pressure stages must be read as a sketch, not universal process settings.

1.Synthesis and flashing

The autoclave produces an equilibrium mixture of urea, water and carbamate/unconverted reactants. Pressure reduction and heat transfer in successive recovery stages decompose residual carbamate and disengage NH3/CO2 from the liquid. The urea-rich solution continues downstream.

2.Distinct recovery streams

The source identifies high-pressure recycle solution separately from a low-pressure ammonia-bearing gas used in by-product manufacture. It is incorrect to redraw all of these streams as one compulsory complete-recycle loop. Stage-wise recovery conserves reactants only within its actual chosen boundary.

3.Vacuum concentration and prilling

After reactant removal, the liquid is concentrated under the selected vacuum arrangement and solidified in the prilling tower. Cooling air removes heat;dust/ammonia-bearing exhaust and off-spec solids require their own recovery or treatment. Biuret/moisture testing qualifies the product.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Corrosion, recovery losses, hot-residence time, vacuum performance, biuret and prill strength/caking are major concerns.

Applications / product boundary

Alternative fertilizer-urea process explanation corresponding to the supplied Montecatini sheet.

body.en:
Ammonia train

Sulfur/CO/CO2 contamination poisons catalysts;reforming can suffer carbon deposition and tube overheating. Compression uses substantial energy and requires reliable seals/anti-surge protection as designed. Exothermic synthesis needs temperature control, inert purge and useful heat recovery. Storage/transfer must prevent toxic releases.

Nitric-acid train

Oxidation selectivity, catalyst loss, NO xabsorption and N2O/NO xemissions affect efficiency/environment. Corrosion depends on acid strength, temperature and material selection;simply choosing any stainless steel is not adequate. Acid concentration adds water/energy-balance and dehydrating-agent carryover issues.

Urea train

Hot carbamate streams are corrosive;compatible materials and the process-specific protective system are essential. Unconverted-reactant recovery and water balance control yield. Excessive hot residence forms biuret;poor finishing causes dust, weak particles and caking. Ammonia-bearing vents and process condensate need appropriate recovery/treatment.

Definition / selected route

Ammonium sulphate,(NH4)2SO4,is a water-soluble ammonium-N and sulfate-S fertilizer;the reference route recovers it by gypsum conversion.

Raw materials and principle

Qualified gypsum and ammonium-carbonate solution;other commercial routes use different feeds.

(NH4)2CO3+CaSO4→(NH4)2SO4+CaCO3↓;gypsum hydrate water follows the aqueous balance.

Source identification

Ammonium-carbonate and gypsum storage/feed enter reactors;CaCO3 is separated by filtration/settling before liquor concentration, crystallisation, centrifuging and finishing. This reference route is not direct NH3/H2SO4 neutralisation, which may be explained only as a separate alternative.

Original reference—page 12

Construction and equipment arrangement

Separate feed storage supplies agitated conversion reactors. Filters/Dorr-type settling separate CaCO3;the liquid passes to evaporation/crystallisation and a centrifuge. Steam and condenser/ejector duties provide the selected concentration service.

1.Gypsum conversion and solid removal

Contacting gypsum with ammonium carbonate produces ammonium-sulphate-bearing liquor and precipitated calcium carbonate. Effective mixing/contacting and solids separation determine recovery. The CaCO3 residue is washed/handled separately;it is not the desired ammonium-sulphate crystal product.

2.Crystallisation and finishing

Clarified liquor is concentrated until controlled crystallisation yields product crystals. Centrifuging separates mother liquor, followed by specified drying/cooling and size/grade checks. Mother-liquor recycle requires an impurity/purge balance, not unlimited accumulation of dissolved salts.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Control conversion, gypsum quality, carbonate carryover, crystal growth, mother-liquor losses and ammonia emissions.

Applications / product boundary

N and S fertilizer;ammonium nutrition can acidify soil during nitrification, so suitability requires agronomic assessment.

body.en:
Definition / selected route

Ammonium chloride, NH4Cl, is a soluble ammonium nitrogen salt;the supplied route converts ammonium-sulphate/brine systems through selective salt recovery.

Raw materials and principle

Ammonium sulphate, sodium-chloride brine and process water.

(NH4)2SO4+2NaCl⇌2NH4Cl+Na2SO4(separation-driven salt conversion).

Source identification

Source reactor→Na2SO4 separation→NH4Cl crystalliser→centrifuge→hot-air dryer, with mother-liquor handling. Salt separations depend on the mixed-salt phase behaviour;writing a double-displacement equation alone does not establish complete conversion.

Original reference—page 13

Construction and equipment arrangement

The reference has a steam-heated reactor, rotary filter for sodium-sulphate recovery, crystalliser, centrifuge and hot-air dryer. The mixed-salt liquor and mother liquor link conversion with crystallisation.

1.Mixed-salt conversion and separation

The reactant salt solutions equilibrate in the conversion system. Selected concentration/temperature-dependent solubility permits removal of a sodium-sulphate-rich solid fraction. Filtering that fraction changes the remaining liquor composition toward the ammonium-chloride recovery duty;the equation alone does not guarantee a complete one-pass reaction.

2.NH4Cl crystal recovery

The crystalliser develops the NH4Cl-rich solid phase. Centrifuging separates mother liquor and the dryer removes adhering moisture under the qualified product method. Impurities and chloride-bearing effluent require control;recycle is governed by analysis and salt balance.

Major engineering / quality considerations

Control salt-phase selectivity, product purity, corrosion, caking and mother-liquor disposal.

Applications / product boundary

Specified nitrogen-fertilizer/industrial grades;chloride-sensitive crops/soils require appropriate product selection rather than blanket use.

q.en: State the principle/definition of Ammonia—physical/chemical properties and uses.
q.gu: Ammonia—Physical/Chemical Properties તથા Usesનો સિદ્ધાંત/વ્યાખ્યા જણાવો.

a.en: Ammonia, NH3,is a nitrogen–hydrogen compound and the main intermediate for many nitrogen fertilizers. It is a colourless, pungent gas at ordinary conditions, lighter than air as a pure gas, readily liquefied by appropriate cooling/pressure and very soluble in water. Released cold liquid/vapour can form a dense hazardous cloud despite the pure-gas density comparison. NH3 is a weak base in water:NH3+H2O⇌NH4++OH−.It neutralises acids to ammonium salts, is oxidised to nitric-oxide/nitric-acid intermediates under suitable catalytic conditions, and supplies nitrogen for urea formation with CO2.It is incompatible with several oxidisers and unsuitable materials;aqueous alkalinity does not make it harmless.
a.gu: Ammonia, NH3,nitrogen–hydrogen compound તથા અનેક nitrogen fertilizers નું મુખ્ય intermediate છે. Ordinary conditions માં colourless, pungent gas છે;pure gas air કરતાં હળવો, યોગ્ય cooling/pressure થી liquefy થતો તથા water માં ખૂબ soluble છે. Cold liquid/vapour release થી dense hazardous cloud બની શકે;ફક્ત pure-gas density પરથી safe માનવું નહીં. Water માં NH3 weak base છે:NH3+H2O⇌NH4++OH−. Acids સાથે ammonium salts બનાવે છે, catalytic oxidation થી nitric-acid intermediates તથા CO2 સાથે urea માટે N આપે છે. કેટલાક oxidisers/materials સાથે incompatible છે;aqueous alkalinity એટલે harmless નહીં.

a.en: Nitric acid, HNO3,is a mineral acid used to supply nitrate nitrogen and in chemical manufacture. Pure acid is colourless;dissolved nitrogen oxides may impart yellow/brown colour. It is miscible with water and corrosive. Conventional HNO3–water distillation has an azeotropic limitation, so stronger acid requires a suitable concentration route. It is a strong acid and a powerful oxidising agent:neutralisation forms nitrate salts and reactions with reducing/organic materials can be dangerous. Nitrogen-oxide formation depends on reactants and conditions. Uses include qualified nitrate fertilizers and chemical intermediates;never mix nitric acid with incompatible organics in an improvised apparatus.
a.gu: Nitric acid, HNO3,nitrate nitrogen તથા chemical manufacture માટેનું mineral acid છે. Pure acid colourless છે;dissolvedNOx થી yellow/brown colour આવી શકે. Water સાથે miscible તથા corrosive છે. Ordinary HNO3–water distillation માં azeotropic limit હોવાથી stronger acid માટે અલગ suitable route જોઈએ. તે strong acid તથા powerful oxidising agent છે;neutralisation થી nitrate salts મળે છે અને reducing/organic materials સાથે જોખમ થાય છે. NO xformation reactants/conditions મુજબ છે. Qualified nitrate fertilizers તથા intermediates માં ઉપયોગ;improvised apparatus માં incompatible organics સાથે mix ન કરવું.

a.en: Urea, CO(NH2)2,is an amide fertilizer and carbon–nitrogen compound, not an ammonium salt. It is a white crystalline, water-soluble solid, sold in qualified prilled/granular forms. Moisture uptake, caking and particle-size distribution affect storage and spreading. Pure-compound theoretical N content is about46.65%;commercial analysis must be read separately. Hydrolysis can release ammonia through the action of urease. Upon excessive thermal exposure, urea can form biuret with ammonia loss;biuret is therefore a quality concern. Urea supplies fertilizer N and is also an industrial chemical feed, including selected resin and diesel-exhaust-fluid manufacture with strict grade requirements.

Moisture, caking તથા particle size storage/spreading ને અસર કરે છે. Pure theoreticalN લગભગ 46.65%છે;commercial analysis અલગ વાંચવી. Urease થી hydrolysis માં ammonia છૂટે છે. q.en: State the principle/definition of Major engineering problems—ammonia,nitric acid and urea.
q.gu: Ammonia,Nitric Acid તથા Ureaની Major Engineering Problemsનો સિદ્ધાંત/વ્યાખ્યા જણાવો.

a.en: Sulfur/CO/CO2 contamination poisons catalysts;reforming can suffer carbon deposition and tube overheating. Compression uses substantial energy and requires reliable seals/anti-surge protection as designed. Exothermic synthesis needs temperature control, inert purge and useful heat recovery. Storage/transfer must prevent toxic releases. Oxidation selectivity, catalyst loss, NO xabsorption and N2O/NO xemissions affect efficiency/environment. Corrosion depends on acid strength, temperature and material selection;simply choosing any stainless steel is not adequate. Acid concentration adds water/energy-balance and dehydrating-agent carryover issues.
a.gu: Sulfur/CO/CO2 થી catalyst poisoning, reforming માં carbon deposition/tube overheating થાય છે. Compression energy, seals/anti-surge protection મહત્વનાં છે. Synthesis માં temperature, inert purge/heat recovery તથા storage/transfer માં toxic-release prevention જોઈએ. Oxidation selectivity, catalyst loss, NO xabsorption તથા N2O/NO xemissions efficiency/environment ને અસર કરે છે. Corrosion acid strength, temperature/material મુજબ છે;કોઈપણ stainless steel પૂરતું નથી. Concentration માં water/energy balance તથા separation-aid carryover ના મુદ્દા ઉમેરાય છે.
